about: Provenance and corresponding source of the third-party binaries shipped unmodified in the Bridge installer (flowseal/<version>/bin). Checked in CI: the installed files must have exactly these SHA-256 values. Human-readable version: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

binaryOrigin.note: The four engine files of Flowseal 1.10.4 are byte-identical to the files at this path of the official zapret v72.9 release (and to its sha256sum.txt).

components.name: winws

source.buildInstructions: docs/windows.md and nfq/Makefile in that source (built with Cygwin)

components.links: cygwin1.dll and WinDivert.dll through the Windows import table (load-time dynamic linking); zlib is linked statically (zlib license, from the Cygwin build environment)
